This 2022 Audi RS 6 combines sophisticated engineering with commanding performance, offering a vehicle designed for drivers who demand both capability and refinement.

- Sport Exhaust
- Dynamic Ride Control Suspension
- Driver Assistance Package with Adaptive Cruise Assist and Lane Guidance
- Carbon Optic Package with 22" forged wheels and carbon mirror housings
- Executive Package featuring Head-Up Display and power soft-closing doors
- Heated Rear Seats
- Steel Red Brake Calipers
- Bang & Olufsen 3D Premium Sound System
- MMI Navigation Plus with touchscreen interface
- Heated and Ventilated Front RS Sport Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Power Moonroof
- Extended Leather Package
- Audi Guard Protection Kit
- Audi connect CARE emergency communication

The RS 6 is powered by a 4.0-liter turbocharged V8 engine producing 591 horsepower, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and quattro all-wheel drive. This powertrain delivers the blend of acceleration and composed handling that distinguishes this model, while the Dynamic Ride Control Suspension adapts to varying road conditions to optimize comfort and performance.

The exterior presents a purposeful presence with Glacier White Metallic paint, carbon fiber mirror housings, and striking 22-inch trapezoid-design wheels finished in gloss anthracite black with diamond-cut detailing. The black optic styling package adds refinement through darkened badges, grille surround, and window trim, while black roof rails complete the athletic aesthetic.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes both luxury and usability. Valcona leather seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear seats ensure comfort across all passengers and seasons. The power soft-closing doors operate with precision engineering, while the head-up display projects essential driving information directly into your line of sight. The executive package components—including extended leather appointments throughout—create an environment of quality craftsmanship and attention to detail.

The driver assistance package enhances every journey with adaptive cruise control featuring lane guidance, intersection assist technology, traffic sign recognition, and side assist monitoring. Audi's pre sense rear system and rear cross traffic assist add layers of awareness and protection. The rear parking camera integrates seamlessly with the MMI navigation system for effortless maneuvering.

This RS 6 is finished with Audi Guard Protection Kit components including all-weather floor mats and cargo protection. With approximately 39,818 miles on the odometer, this vehicle represents an opportunity to own a meticulously engineered performance sedan at a stage where Audi's renowned build quality has proven itself in real-world use. We invite you to experience the combination of power, precision, and purposeful luxury that defines this model.

Experience the electrifying fusion of Scandinavian elegance and track-inspired performance in this one-owner 2023 Volvo V60 T8 Polestar Engineered, finished in sophisticated Thunder Grey Metallic. This rare plug-in hybrid wagon unleashes a thrilling combined 455 horsepower and 523 lb-ft of torque from its advanced 2.0-liter turbocharged direct-injection engine paired with a potent electric motor, seamlessly delivered through an eight-speed automatic transmission with start-stop technology. Polestar’s signature engineering elevates every mile with adjustable Öhlins dampers that deliver razor-sharp handling, powerful Brembo brakes accented by striking gold calipers, a reinforced front strut bar, and 19-inch forged alloy wheels wrapped in summer tires, creating a driving experience that feels both precise and exhilarating.

Slip inside and the cabin envelops you in refined luxury, where Nappa leather front sport seats and leatherette rear seats with open-grid textile pair beautifully with a charcoal headliner and metal-mesh aluminum inlays. A laminated panoramic moonroof with power sunshade bathes the interior in natural light, while heated front and rear seats, a heated steering wheel, and a crisp graphical head-up display ensure every journey remains comfortable and connected. The 12.3-inch progressive digital driver display and 9-inch integrated touchscreen come alive with Google built-in, offering Google Maps, Google Assistant, and the Google Play Store, all powered by the immersive Bowers & Wilkins Premium Sound system and supported by the Digital Services Package for seamless connectivity and remote access through the Volvo Cars App.

Safety and everyday convenience reach new heights with Pilot Assist driver assistance, adaptive cruise control, a 360-degree surround-view camera, blind-spot information with steer assist, cross-traffic alert with auto-brake, and Volvo’s comprehensive collision avoidance systems that detect vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, and large animals. Keyless entry and drive with illuminated door handles, a power-operated tailgate, HomeLink garage-door transmitter, and hidden tailpipes complete the polished package. This meticulously cared-for one-owner example stands ready to deliver the perfect balance of explosive hybrid performance, effortless efficiency, and understated luxury that only a Polestar Engineered V60 can provide.

This Limited trim reflects Subaru's commitment to delivering quality in a package designed for real-world ownership. TWELVE THOUSAND MILES ON A 2021!

Most listings bury the interesting part. Here it is in the second paragraph instead. This Kia Soul has 12,890 miles on it, which for a 2021 is remarkable, and its service file shows that an authorized Kia dealer has handled the ECU upgrade recall. It was done by Overturf Kia in Pasco.

It comes with a full maintenance inspection, safety inspection, brakes checked, coolant checked, battery and charging system checked and a fresh oil and filter. The car has no accidents, no damage, and a clean title.

THE VEHICLE

2021 Kia Soul LX in Snow White Pearl over Black. 12,890 miles. 2.0L multi-point injection four cylinder, Intelligent Variable Transmission, front wheel drive, four door hatchback. Built in Gwangju, Korea and delivered to Car Pros Kia of Huntington Beach, California.

THE ORIGINAL WINDOW STICKER

Base MSRP was $19,090.00. Added equipment: Snow White Pearl paint at $345.00 and carpeted floor mats at $135.00, bringing MSRP including options to $19,570.00. With $1,175.00 inland freight and handling, TOTAL MANUFACTURER'S SUGGESTED RETAIL PRICE was $20,745.00.

HOW IT IS EQUIPPED

From the factory sticker: seven inch touchscreen with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. Rear view camera with dynamic guidelines. Bluetooth wireless technology and a USB multimedia port. Air conditioning. Cruise control. Drive Mode Select. Idle Stop and Go. Power windows, door locks and outside mirrors. Remote keyless entry. Steering wheel mounted audio controls. Tilt and telescopic steering column. 60/40 split-folding rear seats. Center console with armrest and storage bin. Auto on and off headlights, rear privacy glass, roof rack mounting points, 16 inch wheels with covers, and body color mirrors and door handles.

Safety, all standard: dual front advanced airbags, front seat-mounted side airbags, full-length side curtain airbags, LATCH, anti-lock brakes with Brake Assist, traction control, Vehicle Stability Management, Hill-start Assist Control and tire pressure monitoring.

EPA rated 30 MPG combined, 28 city, 33 highway, with a projected $750 saved in fuel over five years against the average new vehicle.

THE CARFAX

No accidents or damage reported. No structural damage, no airbag deployment, no total loss, no odometer rollback, every title brand guaranteed clean. It carries the CARFAX Regular Oil Changes badge. Kia dealers in California handled the scheduled services at 1,539, 3,357 and 5,591 miles, the last including brakes, fluids, a fuel system service and tire rotation. It came to Kennewick in October 2024.

TWO MORE THINGS TO KNOW

There is an outstanding Kia Customer Satisfaction Campaign on this vehicle, number CS2312, covering a theft deterrent ignition cylinder protector. The remedy is available and any authorized Kia dealer performs it. It is a customer satisfaction campaign rather than a safety recall, and CARFAX reports no open safety recalls.

The original factory warranty is estimated to have expired. Kia's powertrain coverage terms differ between the original owner and later owners, so confirm exactly what applies to this VIN with Kia before you buy.

A 2021 with under thirteen thousand miles is a rare thing at this price. Come look at it, ask us anything, and take the CARFAX with you.

A negotiable documentary service fee of $200.00 may apply to each purchase.

When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. description: ONLY 47K MILES, DISTINCTIVE STYLE, NONSMOKER, PRACTICAL & FUN! Few compact cars have a personality quite like the 2021 Kia Soul. Its unmistakable upright shape creates a surprising amount of passenger and cargo room within a city-friendly footprint, while Mars Orange gives this LX an especially distinctive look. With only about 48,000 miles, this Soul offers the kind of everyday practicality that makes it equally comfortable handling a commute, errands, or a weekend away. Under the hood is Kia's 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with an Intelligent Variable Transmission (IVT). The combination emphasizes smooth, efficient everyday driving, while the Soul's compact dimensions, excellent outward visibility, and easy maneuverability make it particularly well suited to crowded streets and parking lots. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Soul's boxy shape isn't merely a styling exercise -- it is one of the reasons the vehicle works so well. The tall roof creates generous headroom, the upright seating position makes getting in and out easy, and the squared-off rear provides useful cargo space without requiring the exterior dimensions of a larger SUV. That versatility is paired with a refreshingly straightforward driving experience. The Soul is easy to place on the road, comfortable enough for longer trips, and economical enough to make sense as a daily commuter. For shoppers who want practical transportation without disappearing into a parking lot full of conventional compact cars, it remains a standout. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The third-generation Kia Soul received strong reviews for its combination of value, interior space, distinctive design, and everyday usability. Automotive reviewers particularly appreciated how effectively Kia translated the Soul's compact exterior dimensions into a roomy passenger compartment. The 2021 Soul also continued the model's reputation as an unconventional alternative to both traditional hatchbacks and small crossovers, giving buyers SUV-like seating and cargo versatility in an especially manageable package. Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 47,967-mile mark. Based on its October 7, 2020 original registration date, the original 5-year/60,000-mile Kia basic warranty has expired by time. Kia's original 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty generally applies to the original owner and should not be represented as continuing factory coverage for a subsequent retail purchaser without qualifying documentation. Extended service plans may be available to provide additional protection and peace of mind moving forward. Standard Features Even in LX form, the Soul delivers the essentials buyers use every day. Its tall cabin provides comfortable seating for five, while the rear seat folds to create additional room when cargo takes priority over passengers. Air conditioning, power windows and locks, remote keyless entry, a rearview camera, steering-wheel-mounted controls, and modern connectivity make this an approachable daily driver without unnecessary complexity. Mechanical Features The 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine produces 147 horsepower and is paired with Kia's Intelligent Variable Transmission. Rather than chasing outright performance, this powertrain is designed around predictable response, everyday efficiency, and easy operation in stop-and-go traffic. Front-wheel drive keeps the mechanical layout straightforward, while the Soul's relatively compact footprint makes it easy to maneuver. Its upright driving position provides excellent visibility for a small vehicle, helping it feel at home in everything from suburban traffic to tight urban streets. Exterior Features Mars Orange is exactly the kind of color that suits the Soul's personality. Rather than hiding its unconventional shape, the vivid finish emphasizes the tall roofline, upright proportions, and distinctive rear profile that have made the Soul instantly recognizable through multiple generations. The compact exterior dimensions also serve a practical purpose. The Soul fits easily into smaller parking spaces while retaining four conventional passenger doors and a large rear liftgate, making it an appealing alternative for buyers who want useful interior space without stepping up to a larger crossover. Interior Features The Soul makes exceptionally good use of its footprint. Its tall roofline provides generous headroom in both rows, while the upright seating position makes entry and exit easier than in many conventional compact cars. The cabin accommodates seating for five without feeling unnecessarily bulky from behind the wheel. A folding rear seat expands the cargo area when larger items need to come along. That flexibility makes the Soul useful for groceries, luggage, everyday household purchases, and weekend gear while still remaining compact enough to be an easy commuter. Infotainment & Technology A touchscreen infotainment system gives the Soul a modern interface for entertainment and compatible smartphone functions. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility allow drivers to access familiar navigation, music, messaging, and other supported applications through the vehicle's display. Bluetooth connectivity and steering-wheel-mounted audio controls further simplify everyday use, allowing frequently used functions to remain conveniently accessible while driving. Safety Features The Soul's upright design and generous glass area provide good outward visibility, an underrated advantage during everyday driving. A rearview camera adds useful assistance when reversing, while electronic stability control, traction control, anti-lock braking, and a comprehensive airbag system provide important foundational safety technology. As with any driver-assistance or safety system, these features supplement rather than replace attentive driving. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line With only about 48,000 miles, distinctive Mars Orange paint, excellent space utilization, smartphone integration, and a straightforward 2.0-liter powertrain, this 2021 Kia Soul LX delivers a lot of everyday usefulness in a remarkably manageable package. It's practical enough to make sense -- and different enough to make the daily drive a little more interesting. Premium amenities throughout establish this S5 as a luxury performance vehicle. The Bang & Olufsen Sound System with 3D Sound elevates every drive, while MMI Navigation Plus keeps you informed. The panoramic glass roof with variable light control floods the cabin with natural light. LED interior lighting pro package creates an upscale ambiance, and multiple USB power delivery points keep your devices charged.

The 2025 Cadillac CT5 V-Series brings performance and refinement together in a package designed for drivers who refuse to compromise. This Black sedan combines distinctive styling with purposeful engineering to deliver a vehicle that performs as well as it looks.

- Ultraview Dual Pane Sunroof spanning both rows of seating
- 3.0L V6 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- Jet Black leather seating with Mini-Perforated inserts and Carbon Fiber trim
- Ventilated driver and front passenger seat cushions and seatbacks
- Red front and rear calipers with matching painted key fobs
- Heated steering wheel and memory seat function
- Google Built-In Infotainment Experience with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay
- AKG Premium 15-Speaker System with SiriusXM 360L capability
- Navigation system with Google Automotive Services capability
- LED Reflective Windshield Collision Alert
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass
- 19-inch aluminum alloy wheels with Satin Graphite finish
- Automatic Stop/Start capability with disable option
- Adaptive suspension with speed-sensing steering

Every detail reflects the V-Series commitment to performance. The responsive 3.0L V6 paired with a 10-speed automatic delivers capable acceleration and highway presence, while achieving 18 city and 27 highway mpg. The adaptive suspension system and speed-sensing steering create confidence in every corner, whether navigating city streets or open roads.

Inside, the Jet Black leather interior with Mini-Perforated inserts and Carbon Fiber accents establishes an upscale environment. Ventilated front seats keep you comfortable during extended drives, while the heated steering wheel and dual-zone climate control adapt to your preferences. The memory seat function and power lumbar support ensure your ideal driving position is always available.

Technology integrates seamlessly with the Google Built-In Infotainment Experience, offering intuitive navigation and smartphone integration through both Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. The AKG Premium 15-Speaker System delivers refined audio quality whether you're enjoying SiriusXM 360L or your personal music library. Safety features include LED Reflective Windshield Collision Alert and a comprehensive airbag system covering dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead placements.

The exterior commands attention with its Black finish, body-color heated power-adjustable mirrors, and distinctive red calipers that signal V-Series performance. The Ultraview Dual Pane Sunroof spans both rows, flooding the cabin with natural light. Torch red seat belt color and matching painted key fobs complete the purposeful design language.

This V-Series offers serious capability backed by warranty coverage, ensuring your investment is protected. Visit our showroom to experience the combination of performance, luxury, and engineering that defines this distinguished sedan.

The 2019 Porsche Panamera GTS AWD occupies the sweet spot in Porsche's four-door lineup, and this particular example has covered a genuinely favorable amount of ground for its age. Finished in Carrara White Metallic, this Panamera was ordered with the SportDesign Package, Premium Package Plus, and 21-inch Exclusive Design Wheels, additions that together make it a considerably more desirable example than a typically equipped GTS. Standard Sport Chrono and a genuinely potent twin-turbo V8 give this Panamera the kind of driver-focused character that has always defined the GTS badge within Porsche's lineup. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The Panamera GTS earned its reputation as the enthusiast's choice within the Panamera lineup, bridging the gap between the more relaxed V6 models and the outright power of the Turbo with a genuinely sharper, more engaging driving character. Owners consistently point to its standard Sport Chrono package, adaptive air suspension, and larger brakes as reasons they chose the GTS over a more comfort-oriented Panamera. Buyers are also drawn to the GTS's standard sport exhaust and 10mm-lower ride height, details that give this Panamera a genuinely more focused, connected feel behind the wheel without sacrificing the everyday usability a four-door Porsche demands. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Automotive journalists have consistently praised the Panamera GTS for striking a genuine sweet spot within the lineup, delivering meaningfully sharper handling and a more connected driving experience than the standard Panamera without the compromises that come with the range-topping Turbo models. WARRANTY The odometer on this Panamera is hovering around the 31,072-mile mark, and although the original factory warranty has expired, this Panamera has covered a genuinely favorable amount of ground for its age, averaging under 4,300 miles per year since new. Extended service plans may be available to provide additional peace of mind and help protect your investment moving forward. STANDARD FEATURES The GTS trim gives buyers a genuinely more focused Panamera right out of the gate, with standard Sport Chrono, a sport exhaust with black tailpipes, and adaptive air suspension riding 10mm lower than a standard Panamera. Larger front and rear brakes come standard as well, giving this GTS genuinely confident stopping power to match its added performance. Black Alcantara interior accents, anodized aluminum trim, and a heated multifunction steering wheel round out a cabin built specifically around the GTS's driver-focused character. INSTALLED OPTIONS Premium Package Plus BOSE Surround Sound System A 710-watt, 14-channel system with 14 speakers and a subwoofer, further enhanced by AudioPilot noise compensation technology for consistently rich sound at any speed. Lane Change Assist Alerts the driver to vehicles in the blind spot before changing lanes. Soft Close Doors Gently pulls each door shut the rest of the way, a subtle but genuinely luxurious detail. Front and Rear Seat Heating Keeps every occupant comfortable on cold mornings. Comfort Access Lets the driver unlock and start the Panamera without ever removing the key from a pocket or bag. LED Headlights with Porsche Dynamic Light System Automatically adjusts beam pattern and intensity for the road ahead, improving visibility without blinding oncoming traffic. SportDesign Package Painted in High-Gloss Black Gives this Panamera a sleeker, more monochromatic exterior treatment that suits the GTS's sportier personality. Standalone Features 21'' Exclusive Design Wheels in High-Gloss Black Gives this Panamera a sharper, more upscale stance than the standard 20-inch wheel design. Head-Up Display Projects key driving information directly into the driver's line of sight, a first-time option for the Panamera lineup. Black/Bordeaux Red Leather Interior A distinctive two-tone leather treatment that stands apart from a standard single-color interior. Storage Package Adds genuinely useful additional storage solutions throughout the cabin. Ambient Lighting Adds a more upscale ambiance throughout the cabin after dark. Rear Wiper Keeps the rear window clear in wet weather for improved visibility. MECHANICAL FEATURES This Panamera GTS is powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V8 producing 453 horsepower and 457 lb-ft of torque, enough for a 0-to-60 run in about 3.9 seconds, genuinely quick territory for a full-size luxury sedan. The 8-speed PDK dual-clutch transmission delivers lightning-quick, precise shifts that suit the GTS's performance-oriented character. Standard all-wheel drive and Porsche Active Suspension Management work together to deliver genuinely composed, confident handling regardless of road conditions, while the standard Sport Chrono package sharpens throttle response and enables launch control at the push of a button. EXTERIOR FEATURES This Panamera's Carrara White Metallic finish gives it a clean, sophisticated presence that suits its sculpted, aerodynamic body lines especially well. The SportDesign Package's high-gloss black exterior elements and the 21-inch Exclusive Design Wheels reinforce that same sportier, more purposeful character. Black exterior trim details and the GTS's standard black-tipped sport exhaust round out a genuinely distinctive presence that sets this Panamera apart from a standard model. INTERIOR FEATURES The Black and Bordeaux Red two-tone leather interior gives this Panamera's cabin a genuinely distinctive, upscale look that stands apart from a standard single-color interior. Front and rear seat heating, part of the Premium Package Plus, keeps every occupant comfortable regardless of the season. Ambient lighting and the Storage Package's additional cabin storage solutions round out an interior that's just as thoughtful as it is luxurious. The white-finished Sport Chrono stopwatch dial adds a distinctive visual touch to the dashboard. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY The Head-Up Display projects essential driving information directly into the driver's line of sight, a genuinely useful feature that was new to the Panamera lineup for this generation. The BOSE Surround Sound System fills the cabin with genuinely rich, immersive audio, further refined by AudioPilot noise compensation technology. Comfort Access adds a genuine layer of everyday convenience, letting the driver unlock and start the Panamera without ever pulling out the key. SAFETY FEATURES Lane Change Assist helps the driver stay aware of vehicles in the blind spot before changing lanes, adding a genuine layer of confidence on the highway. Porsche's comprehensive airbag system and Porsche Stability Management round out a vehicle built with occupant protection in mind. Together, these systems help this Panamera feel just as reassuring in daily traffic as it is engaging on a winding road. ... and there's SO MUCH more! This is the Panamera for the enthusiast who refuses to compromise an executive luxury sedan with the soul of a sports car. The GTS delivers breathtaking performance, incredible composure, and the unmistakable sophistication that only Porsche can provide.

This example carries a Clean Carfax with no accidents, has been exceptionally well maintained, and has recently had all of its required services completed. The front end is protected by full Paint Protection Film, helping preserve the beautiful Dolomite Silver finish in exceptional condition.

Beautifully Optioned

This Panamera GTS is equipped with an impressive list of luxury, technology, and driver-focused options, including:

It's subtle when you want it to be and authoritative when you open the throttle.

The result is an exhaust note that perfectly complements the GTS without overwhelming the luxury experience.

The GTS Experience

The Panamera GTS is uniquely capable of delivering two completely different personalities. Around town, it is quiet, refined, incredibly comfortable, and beautifully composed. When the road opens up, the GTS comes alive with exceptional acceleration, sharp handling, and the confidence of Porsche's legendary engineering.

Elegant enough for the valet. Aggressive enough for the open road.

This Panamera GTS is ready for its next owner and represents an exceptional opportunity to own a beautifully preserved Porsche that delivers luxury, technology, performance, and presence in one unforgettable package.

Sophisticated. Athletic. Unmistakably Porsche.

Four-wheel independent suspension, speed-sensing steering, and electronic stability control work together to provide confident handling. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags contribute to comprehensive occupant protection.

Comfort features address both driver and passenger needs comprehensively. Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C and rear window defroster ensure climate comfort for all occupants. The power driver seat with lumbar support and seat memory allows customization to your preferences, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror and delay-off headlights demonstrate thoughtful engineering in everyday details.

This BMW 5 Series 540i is ready for a test drive at our showroom. We invite you to experience the combination of performance, luxury, and technology that makes this sedan a compelling option in its class.

- Intuitive Parking Assist & Panoramic View Monitor
- Navigation with Mark Levinson Audio and 12.3" Touch Screen
- Head-Up Display (HUD)
- Hands-Free Power Open/Close Trunk
- 18" Split-5-Spoke Alloy Wheels

The exterior presents a striking black finish that commands attention while maintaining the sophisticated aesthetic Lexus is known for. The 18-inch alloy wheels feature a distinctive split-5-spoke design with noise-reduction technology and high-gloss finish, enhancing both appearance and performance.

Inside, the cabin showcases genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts alongside wood trim with ambient lighting, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury. The heated leather and wood three-spoke steering wheel welcomes you each time you enter, while the 14-way power adjustable heated and ventilated front seats ensure your comfort throughout every journey. Semi-aniline leather seat trim and a power rear sunshade contribute to the premium ambiance throughout the cabin.

Technology integration is comprehensive with the Lexus Interface featuring an 8-inch multimedia touch screen paired with the Mark Levinson audio system. The head-up display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, while the navigation system with drive connect and cloud navigation keeps you confidently on course. Wireless charging and wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity seamlessly integrate your smartphone into the driving experience.

Safety and convenience features include the intuitive parking assist with panoramic view monitor using front, side, and rear cameras with auto-braking capability. Intelligent clearance sonar and rear pedestrian detection work together to provide comprehensive awareness around the vehicle. The hands-free power trunk operated by kick sensor adds practical convenience, while SmartAccess key card functionality eliminates the need for traditional keys.

This 2023 Lexus ES 300h Luxury represents a thoughtful investment in quality, efficiency, and refined driving pleasure. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this exceptional sedan firsthand.

Premium leather seating surfaces wrap the front bucket seats with power adjustment on both sides and heating for cold mornings. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort during winter months. The sophisticated interior incorporates genuine wood accents on the dashboard, door panels, and console, creating a refined atmosphere that elevates each drive.

The Bang & Olufsen premium sound system delivers concert-quality audio through 10 speakers, while the wireless phone charging keeps your device ready for the road. Safety features include the Top View Camera System with virtual 360-degree views, Audi Side Assist with Pre Sense Rear, and Adaptive Cruise Assist with Lane Guidance to support your confidence behind the wheel.

The exterior presents a commanding presence with Matrix-Design LED headlights that adjust automatically for optimal visibility. Auto High-beam technology engages when appropriate, while the power moonroof opens your connection to the sky. The 19-inch platinum gray dynamic design wheels combine aesthetic appeal with functional performance, and the gray exterior color provides an elegant, timeless appearance.

This 2024 Audi A6 55 Premium Plus quattro invites you to experience the combination of luxury, technology, and performance that defines premium sedan ownership. We welcome the opportunity to introduce you to this vehicle and answer any questions about its capabilities and features.

This 2024 Toyota Camry XSE in Blue represents a refined midsize sedan that delivers both comfort and efficiency for your daily driving needs.

- Panoramic glass roof with front power tilt/slide
- Multi-stage heated front bucket seats with perforated leather trim
- Heated steering wheel
- Cold Weather Package
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Exterior parking camera with rear view
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- All-weather floor liners and cargo tray
- Power driver and passenger seats

- SiriusXM satellite radio

The XSE trim balances practical features with everyday convenience. This Camry offers a 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission, delivering 27 mpg in city driving and 38 mpg on the highway. The spacious interior accommodates five passengers with front bucket seats and a split folding rear seat for flexible cargo management. Remote keyless entry, power windows and door mirrors, and illuminated entry make routine operation effortless.

Safety is integrated throughout this sedan. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and rear side impact airbags work alongside an advanced suspension system featuring four-wheel independent components and speed-sensing steering. Electronic Stability Control and traction control provide confidence in various driving conditions. The rear parking camera aids in backing safely, while low tire pressure warning keeps you informed of your tire status.

Comfort features distinguish the XSE experience. Automatic headlights with delay-off functionality and heated door mirrors enhance visibility and convenience. The power steering and telescoping steering wheel adjust to your preferences. A trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information, while the overhead console and door bins maximize storage options.

The panoramic glass roof creates an open, airy cabin that brightens the driving environment. Heated seats and the heated steering wheel prove particularly valuable during colder months. The power rear window defroster and variably intermittent wipers ensure clear visibility in changing weather conditions.

This 2024 Camry XSE comes equipped to handle real-world driving with practical touches including mudguards for protection, a hide-away cargo net for organization, and trunk LED lighting for nighttime visibility. Experience refined luxury and advanced technology in this 2024 Toyota Crown XLE sedan, finished in striking Supersonic Red. With just over 30,000 miles, this used vehicle offers a compelling blend of reliability and style. Powered by a 2.5-liter naturally aspirated four-cylinder hybrid engine delivering 236 horsepower, it combines impressive fuel efficiency—42 mpg city and 41 mpg highway—with all-wheel drive for confident handling. The sleek four-door design seats five comfortably, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a practical yet premium ride.

Equipped with a suite of driver-assistance and convenience features, this Crown XLE ensures a safer, more comfortable drive. Adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, and collision warning work together to enhance safety on busy roads. Inside, enjoy heated seats, keyless entry, push start, and a wireless phone charging pad, while connectivity is seamless with Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, satellite radio readiness, and a Wi-Fi hotspot. The 12.3-inch infotainment touchscreen, navigation with real-time traffic data, and voice-operated radio and messaging systems keep you connected and entertained.

This Crown XLE prioritizes safety with advanced systems like automatic emergency braking at intersections and junction turns and crossings, helping prevent collisions before they happen. The vehicle is equipped with a check rear seat reminder and a vehicle exit safety system to protect passengers and prevent accidents when parking. Dual knee airbags, ABS on all four wheels, regenerative braking, emergency braking preparation, and power door locks with anti-lockout functionality provide comprehensive security. Additionally, traffic sign recognition and a knee airbags system reinforce occupant safety across all driving conditions.

2024 Toyota Crown Entertainment and Technology Features

Entertainment and connectivity are front and center with a 12.3-inch infotainment screen that offers crisp visuals and intuitive control. Compatibility with Toyota Connected Services allows smart device app integration for remote engine start and cabin preconditioning. Hands-free, voice-operated phone call integration, along with HD radio and real-time traffic navigation data, keep you informed and entertained. The touch screen display simplifies control, while electronic messaging assistance—also voice operated—ensures you stay connected without distraction, making every journey more enjoyable and seamless.

2024 Toyota Crown Performance Features

Performance features include an automatic start/stop system that enhances fuel efficiency and reduces emissions. The Crown is powered by a nickel-metal hydride electric motor battery, providing reliable hybrid performance. The vehicle’s on-demand all-wheel drive system ensures optimal traction and stability in various driving conditions, making it a versatile choice for daily commuting and longer trips alike.

This 2024 BMW 4 Series 430i Gran Coupe represents a sophisticated choice for drivers who appreciate refined performance and contemporary design. With its gray exterior and meticulously crafted interior, this vehicle delivers the kind of presence that commands attention on the road.

- M Sport Package with Aerodynamic Kit and M Sport Suspension
- M Sport Brakes with Red Calipers

The M Sport Package distinguishes this Gran Coupe with purposeful styling that extends beyond aesthetics. The M Sport Suspension, variable sport steering, and aerodynamic enhancements work together to provide responsive handling without compromising comfort. The M Sport brakes with red calipers add both stopping power and visual distinction.

Inside, BMW's commitment to quality is evident throughout. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the Harman/Kardon surround sound system transforms your daily commute. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel provide comfort during colder months, and the wireless device charging keeps your phone powered throughout the day. The BMW Curved Display delivers intuitive controls, and the head-up display projects critical information directly into your line of sight.

Technology integration is comprehensive with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, SiriusXM 360L satellite radio, and ConnectedDrive Services. The parking assistance package includes active park distance control and surround view with 3D view, making tight spaces manageable. Navigation is built-in, ensuring you arrive at your destination with confidence.

This 4 Series represents the intersection of performance, luxury, and practicality. The Gran Coupe body style offers the elegance of a sports car with the functionality of a four-door configuration. Every element, from the shadowline trim to the alloy wheels, has been carefully considered for both form and function. This vehicle is ready to enhance your driving experience and deserves your attention.

The heated steering wheel and rear window defroster add practical conveniences for colder months.

Safety features include lane departure warning, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system with dual front and side impact protection. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering creates predictable handling dynamics. The rear exterior camera and brake assist technology enhance awareness and control in everyday driving situations.

Heated rear seats, a rear center armrest, and split-folding rear seats accommodate passengers and cargo flexibly. The 17-speaker audio system with memory settings and radio data system provides quality sound reproduction, while the trip computer and outside temperature display keep you informed throughout your drive.

All-wheel drive provides confident handling and traction in varied weather conditions, while fuel efficiency ratings of 24 city and 33 highway MPG demonstrate practical everyday capability.

The interior offers genuine wood accents throughout the dashboard and console, creating an atmosphere of refined sophistication. Sport seats wrapped in perforated Sensatec upholstery provide comfort and support for both short commutes and longer journeys. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and illuminated entry complement the premium character of the cabin, while the power moonroof enhances the sense of openness and light.

Lane Departure Warning, Active Blind Spot Detection, and Frontal Collision Warning offer additional layers of protection. The Parking Assistance Package removes uncertainty from tight spaces with active guidance and multiple camera views.

The Connected Package Pro keeps you seamlessly integrated with your digital life, while the Convenience Package ensures daily driving remains effortless. Remote keyless entry, power windows, power door mirrors, and electronic stability control work together to create a driving experience that feels intuitive and composed.

This BMW Certified Pre-Owned vehicle has been thoroughly inspected to confirm its quality and reliability. With this warranty coverage and the complete service history on file, you can drive with confidence knowing this 3 Series has been cared for properly from day one.
